description: Per order status, average the filled quantity over all linked executions with a non-missing fill, counting zero fills as zero.

b.request: For each order status, use only executions linked to an order; report the average non-NULL `fillcount` (including zero fills), the count of all linked executions, and that count divided by the total number of linked executions across all statuses, without rounding
b.sql: SELECT o.orderflow AS order_status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_share FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

a.request: For each order status (`orders.orderflow`), using order executions linked to their order where `orderexecutions.ordersmark` matches `orders.recordvault` (executions with no matching order are left out), show the status, the average filled quantity (`fillcount`) across its executions — ignoring missing values but counting zero fills as zero —, the number of executions, and that number as a fraction of the total number of executions across all statuses. Don't round anything.
a.sql: SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

c.request: For each order status, looking at order executions matched to their order (`orderexecutions.ordersmark` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched executions dropped), show the status, the average filled quantity (`fillcount`), the number of executions, and what fraction of all executions that number is. No rounding. Per order status, average the filled quantity over all linked executions with a non-missing fill, counting zero fills as zero.
c.sql: SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

d.request: For each order status, join `orderexecutions` to `orders` on `orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault` and drop unmatched executions. Show the status, the average `fillcount` across linked executions with a non-missing value (including zero fills), the number of linked executions, and that number as a fraction of all linked executions. Do not round.
d.sql: SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow
